description: Top DeFi protocols by TVL (or 1 d / 7 d TVL change), filterable by chain and category — lending, DEX, liquid staking, bridges, perps… From DefiLlama's full protocol list (~6,000 protocols). Each row: TVL, TVL on the requested chain, 1 h/1 d/7 d change, market cap, category, chains, site. Use for "biggest lending protocols on Base" or "fastest growing DEXes this week". When to use: To rank protocols; for one protocol in depth use defi_protocol. Price: free. Errors: returns isError with a message for invalid input or an upstream failure (not charged).

category.description: e.g. Lending, Dexs, Liquid Staking, Bridge, Derivatives, Yield, CDP, RWA (optional)

chain.description: DefiLlama chain name, e.g. Ethereum, Solana, Base, Arbitrum (optional)

limit.description: How many protocols to return. Range 1-100. Default 25.

min_tvl_usd.description: Skip protocols with less TVL than this (USD). Default 1000000.

sort.description: Rank by current TVL or by 1-day / 7-day TVL change. One of "tvl", "change_1d", "change_7d". Default "tvl".

name: defi_rankings
title: DeFi protocol rankings
